brandPositioningSummary: Home2 Suites by Hilton is an owner-facing midscale extended-stay Home2 Suites by Hilton brand within Hilton Worldwide. Underwrite the asset against this brand's guest promise, product scope, and operating complexity rather than sibling brands or corporate platform averages.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Midscale Extended-Stay Capture
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Home2 Suites fits owners chasing longer stays with midscale efficiency when flexible suite configurations, simplified public space, and cost-conscious operations match demand without Homewood upscale residential intensity or Hampton focused-service positioning.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Suburban Employment Corridor Suites
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Suburban employment and highway corridors create Home2 value when length-of-stay patterns support flexible-suite product. Owners should underwrite parking, guest-laundry, and simplified housekeeping cadence against real project and relocation demand.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Dual-Brand Development Efficiency
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Sites suited to Tru + Home2 dual-brand pairings gain Home2 value when shared land, back-of-house, and construction efficiencies improve returns without compromising the extended-stay guest experience or Hampton focused-service standards.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Secondary Market Extended-Stay Play
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Secondary and tertiary markets can favor Home2 when competitive midscale suite supply is thin. Compare Homewood Suites only when the product tier truly warrants upscale kitchens, hot breakfast, and evening social programming.

scenarios.title: Cost-Conscious Longer-Stay Demand
scenarios.summary: Home2 Suites creates owner value where guests want extended-stay suite space at midscale rates—without full Homewood upscale kitchens, hot breakfast, and evening social overhead. Affiliation fits suburban and highway corridors where employment, relocation, and project demand can fill flexible suite mixes. Owner value weakens when the site is pure transient leisure or when capital assumes upscale extended-stay amenities Home2 was never meant to carry.

scenarios.title: Flexible Suite Configuration Efficiency
scenarios.summary: Flexible-configuration suites and simplified public space create Home2 value for cost-conscious multi-night guests. Underwrite housekeeping cadence, guest-laundry, and back-of-house for longer stays rather than transient select-service assumptions. Capital cases are stronger when the asset serves those guests efficiently—not when the thesis drifts into Homewood residential upscale or Tru new-build focused-service prototypes.

scenarios.title: Efficient Dual-Brand Development Pattern
scenarios.summary: Dual-brand development sites—typically Home2 paired with Tru or Hampton—create Home2 value when shared land, construction, and operating efficiencies lift returns while keeping each brand's guest promise intact. Underwrite the pairing honestly so extended-stay guests still get the Home2 suite experience. Value weakens if the pairing forces compromises Home2 or its sibling brand cannot sustain.
